# Self-hosted runner

The self-hosted runner can be set up in the following environment:
- Rocky Linux 10.2
- Python 3.12.13
- Pip 26.2.1
- Podman 5.8.2
- jupyter-repo2docker 2026.4.0 (installed with pip)
- repo2podman in the version of this commit: 0ddb88e0bb01c3b9f900a7f5de24c0bfd25f13ed (installed with pip)
- issue2docker in the prototype-demo-v2 version (https://gitlab.git.nrw/rpdm/projects-and-services/caesar/issue2docker/-/tree/prototype-demo-v2?ref_type=heads)
